title: The Great Roll and the Witnesses
summary: Nephi reports the Lord's instruction to take a great roll and write concerning Maher-shalal-hash-baz. Nephi then reports taking Uriah the priest and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah as faithful witnesses to record.

explicit_facts.text: The word of the Lord instructs Nephi to take a great roll and write in it with a man's pen concerning Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
Nephi took faithful witnesses to record: Uriah the priest and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi may be shown with the two named witnesses in a depiction of the later reported event, without implying they were present for the instruction.
unspecified_visual_details: The location and the people's appearances are unspecified.
The roll's material and dimensions and the pen's appearance are unspecified.
How the word of the Lord was conveyed is unspecified.
The time between the instruction and the taking of witnesses is unspecified.

spoken_dialogue.text: Take thee a great roll, and write in it with a man’s pen, concerning Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: The Lord

narration.text: Moreover, the word of the Lord said unto me:
And I took unto me faithful witnesses to record, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The supplied context identifies Nephi as the first-person narrator.
The Lord's words are reported; no visible divine appearance is described.

Do not depict Maher-shalal-hash-baz or Jeberechiah as present.
Do not show the witnesses writing on the roll.

title: Prophecy Concerning Assyria and Judah
